hits.name: Varia
hits.description:
Varia is better than your browser at downloading stuff.

      
Supporting videos and torrents on top of just regular files, and with a variety of advanced features wrapped inside an easy to understand interface, Varia is both quite powerful and dead simple to use:

      
        
Download anything you want quickly - potentially faster than your browser, continue incomplete downloads even after reboots

        
Download video and audio (as well as whole playlists) from thousands of websites (anything supported by yt-dlp) including YouTube, TikTok, Twitter etc

        
Integrate with Firefox and Chrome (or any Chromium based browser like Brave or Opera) to redirect downloads

        
Schedule downloads with a powerful scheduler function allowing for custom timespans for each day of the week

        
Download from protected areas with basic auth and cookies.txt import support, as well as an option to automatically transfer your browser cookies through the extension

        
Control a remote aria2 instance running on any server through Remote Mode

hits.name: Ultimate Media Downloader
hits.summary: Media Downloader for YouTube and 1500+ other websites
hits.description:
Ultimate Media Downloader is a fast and open source YouTube downloader for
      Linux and a video downloader for more than 1500 other websites. It saves
      videos, playlists, channels, live streams and music from YouTube,
      Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, X (Twitter), Reddit, Vimeo, SoundCloud,
      Twitch, Kick, Dailymotion, Rumble, Odysee, Bilibili, Bandcamp, Mixcloud,
      Pinterest, Tumblr, Streamable and the Internet Archive. Copy a link from
      Chrome, Firefox or any browser, paste it, pick a preset and download.
    
      Why choose Ultimate Media Downloader?
      
        YouTube video downloader: save videos as MP4, MKV or WEBM in any quality from 144p and 720p HD to 1080p Full HD, 4K and 8K, including 60 fps
        YouTube to MP3 converter, MP3 downloader and music downloader: download YouTube Music songs, albums and playlists, and extract audio as MP3 at 128 to 320 kbps, M4A, Opus or lossless FLAC with tags and cover art
        YouTube playlist downloader and channel downloader: list an entire playlist or channel in seconds and pick exactly the items you want
        YouTube Shorts, live streams and premieres: download Shorts, record a live stream while it runs and grab the VOD afterwards
        Batch downloader and download manager: queue many links, download them all at once, watch progress and open finished files from the download library
        Subtitles and closed captions: download or embed subtitles in the languages a video offers, including auto-generated captions, as SRT, VTT or ASS
        Sign-in required, private, members-only and age-restricted videos: log in once with your Google account in the built-in Chromium-based browser and download what your account can watch
        YouTube search built in: find videos and playlists inside the app and play them without ads
        Custom format selector: choose the exact resolution, codec, container and bitrate when a preset is not enough
        Dark theme, drag and drop, clipboard link detection and a download engine that updates itself so website changes are handled quickly
      
      More than a YouTube downloader
      
        Social video downloader: Facebook video downloader, Instagram Reels and video downloader, TikTok downloader, X (Twitter) video downloader, Reddit video downloader with audio, Pinterest and Tumblr
        Streaming and live: Twitch VOD and clip downloader, Kick, Dailymotion, Rumble, Odysee, Bilibili, Streamable and live stream recording
        Music and podcasts: SoundCloud downloader, Bandcamp, Mixcloud and podcast downloader, saved as MP3, M4A, Opus or FLAC
        Any page with a video: HLS (m3u8) and DASH streams, direct MP4 and MP3 links, embedded players on news sites, blogs, forums and the Internet Archive
      
      
      Built on yt-dlp. Ultimate Media Downloader is a graphical yt-dlp GUI and a
      friendly front end for the youtube-dl successor: every site, format and
      option yt-dlp supports is available from the interface, with no command
      line and no terminal. The yt-dlp engine updates itself inside the app, so
      a YouTube or TikTok change is fixed in hours, not at the next release.
    
      
      Works with the browser you already use. Copy a video link from Google
      Chrome, Chromium, Firefox, Brave or Edge and the app picks it up from the
      clipboard. The built-in Chromium-based browser lets you sign in to
      YouTube, Google, Twitch or Instagram once, so private, unlisted,
      subscriber-only and age-restricted videos download like any other link.
    
      
      Free, open source and offline: nothing is uploaded to a server, there are
      no ads, no watermarks added and no daily limits. A native YouTube desktop
      app, video downloader app and 4K video downloader for any Linux desktop
      (Ubuntu, Fedora, Debian, Arch, openSUSE and Steam Deck via Flatpak), and a
      free alternative to 4KTUBE, 4K Video Downloader, SnapTube, online video
      downloaders and YouTube to MP3 converter websites.

hits.name: Jasmine
hits.description:
Jasmine is a website launcher and session management platform with shared, named or private profiles for each tab. Also featuring Internet Radio, IPTV and Podcasts.
    
      
      Key Features:
    
      
      Core:
    
      
        Smart Bookmarking - Store websites with titles, URLs, comments, favicons, and login references
        Session Management - Create, save, and restore multi-tab sessions with one click
        Flexible Profiles - Choose between shared, named-shared (user-created), or private (incognito) profiles per tab
        Multi-Account Support - Access multiple accounts on the same service without conflicts
      
      
      Media:
    
      
        Internet Radio - Browse, search, and play thousands of stations with local icon caching
        IPTV - Import M3U playlists, browse channels by category, and watch live TV
        Podcast Manager - Subscribe via iTunes search or RSS, manage episodes, and play audio
      
      
      Utilities:
    
      
        Download Manager - Progress tracking and file organization
        Ad Blocker - Block unwanted ads and popups for cleaner browsing
        2FA Integration - Built-in TOTP code generator
      
      
      Security:
    
      
        Master Password Protection - Encrypted data protection
        Private Profiles - Completely isolated browsing environments

hits.name: Vieb
hits.description:
Vim bindings for the web by design.
      Vieb is the Vim Inspired Electron Browser.
      Features:
      
        Free, open source, fast and secure
        Local first adblocking, auto-complete, AMP protection, custom redirects and more, all without web requests
        Privacy with strict permission system, navigator overrides, firefox mode, custom WebRTC policy and more
        Accessible with custom themes, full interface & fontsize scaling, page zooming, spellcheck and mouse support
        Security settings with permissions, cache usage, cookie management, (auto-)download settings and more
        Window splitting with buffer, split, Vexplore and Ctrl-w bindings, for multi-window browsing
        Map commands for completely custom keyboard sequences, keystrokes, commands and actions
        Viebrc config file for all custom/Vim/Vieb commands to configure settings permanently
        Set command for runtime setting configuration exactly like Vim
        Vim-compatible options: showcmd, timeout, colorscheme, maxmapdepth, spelllang, splitright, smartcase etc.
        Container tabs with colored grouping, auto-clearing, individual cookies and tab restore from containers
        Ad-blocker with cosmetic filtering, optional updater, custom lists and uses easylist/easyprivacy by default
        Tabs including audio indicator, a toggle for multi-line tabs, pinned tabs, muted tabs and suspended tabs
        Offline help documentation always available upon pressing F1
        And much, much more. For more details, visit https://vieb.dev/features
